neighbours.label: the preposition that introduces a name or formula ('known under the name', 'sous le nom de', 'a mineral with the formula')
fire: The singer became famous under the name Little Sparrow.
Il était connu sous le nom de Capitaine Noir.
Calcite is a carbonate mineral with the formula CaCO3.
Die Band trat unter dem Namen Blaue Nacht auf.
The writer published his novels under the pseudonym Max Field.
Elle chantait sous le nom de Mademoiselle Rose.
Halite is a sodium chloride mineral with the formula NaCl.
Das Fest fand unter dem Motto Sommerlicht statt.
quiet: The singer became famous after a song on the radio.
Il était connu dans toute la ville pour sa gentillesse.
Calcite is a common mineral found in many caves.
Die Band trat letzte Woche in Berlin auf.
The writer published his novels in a small town.
Elle chantait tous les soirs dans un petit café.
Halite is a soft mineral found near old seas.
Das Fest fand im Garten der Schule statt.
